title: Siena no. 15: Mario Bandini at the imperial court, Innsbruck, 4 January 1547

steps.what: Project survey (siena1421): transcription of the P2/P6 runs (agents K, L) and the filed key R4764 compared by sign style; inconclusive, closed as too short.
George Lasry transcribed the cipher passages in CTTS (71 classes).
Crib guessing and dragging with Claude Opus 5.5 inside the clear context.
75 of 240 signs given a value; code words buf, abs, som, Za unidentified.
Report key figures of nos. 15, 17 and 5 compared sign by sign: different keys (Lambda is c here, e in no. 5; theta e here, z in no. 5; square-U n here, i in no. 17).

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): George Lasry's partial decipherment and translation (reading.txt, translation.txt, lasry_report.md), his key figure and table; transcription = this project's 24 Sept one (project_attempt/), his CTTS transcription not being in the repository.

texts.label: No. 15 (R4803), Mario Bandini to the Signori of Siena, Innsbruck, 4 January 1547 (George Lasry's partial reading)
texts.summary: Mario Bandini, Sienese orator at the imperial court, to the Signori of Siena, Innsbruck, 4 January 1547, after the Schmalkaldic campaign: Piergiovanni Salvestri at Innsbruck with the Florentine orator, an occasion to be used and discord in cipher, a minister (Granvelle?) warning that a fire would be kindled in a coded place, and Sienese vases 'all'antica' for Burgundy via Figueroa. Decryption and translation are George Lasry's (75 of 240 signs); the transcription linked is this project's own of 24 Sept 2026, not used in his reading, since his CTTS transcription is not in the repository.

prior.where: None known; the project's 24 Sept survey left it unread.

human: George Lasry transcribed in CTTS and deciphered part of the cipher with Claude Opus 5.5 by crib guessing and dragging; this project filed his report.
